name: foundation-manifesto
description: Official manifesto of the Catholic Digital Commons Foundation

scripts.build:html: mkdir -p dist && pandoc 'CDCF Manifesto.md' -f markdown -t html5 -o dist/manifesto.html
scripts.build:html:standalone: mkdir -p dist && pandoc 'CDCF Manifesto.md' --standalone --embed-resources --css scripts/manifesto-print.css -f markdown -t html5 -o dist/manifesto-standalone.html
